images.name: 01-one-click-empties-your-inventory.png
images.head: One click empties your inventory
images.sub: The haul goes in the chest. Locked slots stay put.
images.store_description: Press the button next to the chest and every unlocked slot empties into it. The sword, pickaxe, torches and food were locked, so they stayed behind.

images.name: 02-lock-the-slots-you-keep.png
images.head: Lock the slots you keep
images.sub: Hold Left Alt and click a slot. It turns blue.
images.store_description: Hold Left Alt and click any inventory or hotbar slot to lock it. Locked slots are tinted blue and Quick Deposit never touches them. Click again to unlock.

images.name: 03-locks-stay-with-you.png
images.head: Locks stay with you
images.sub: They show in your own inventory and are saved between sessions.
images.store_description: Locks belong to the slot, not the item, so whatever you keep in that slot stays protected. They show in your normal inventory too and are saved between sessions.

images.name: 04-chests-barrels-and-shulker-boxes.png
images.head: Chests, barrels and shulker boxes
images.sub: Ender chests and double chests too.
images.store_description: The button shows up on chests, double chests, barrels, ender chests and shulker boxes. A shulker box never gets another shulker box pushed into it.

images.name: 05-a-full-chest-is-fine.png
images.head: A full chest is fine
images.sub: Whatever doesn't fit stays in your inventory.
images.store_description: Quick Deposit fills what space there is and stops. Anything that doesn't fit stays where it was, so nothing ends up on the floor.
